title: Dear Ms. Tanaka,
L: Thank you for choosing the Ashford Hotel for your company's sales conference on June 8.
We are writing to let you know that the Lakeview Room, which you reserved, will receive new carpeting during the first week of June.
The work may not be finished in time for your conference.
We would therefore like to move your event to the Garden Room, which is slightly larger and has a beautiful view of our park.
There will be no change to the price you were quoted.
We apologize for any disruption this may cause, and we look forward to welcoming your group.

exq.why: Việc lắp thảm sắp diễn ra (during the first week of June, trước hội nghị 8/6) → tương lai: will receive.

exq.a: The work may not be finished in time for your conference.
w: The hotel restaurant serves breakfast from 6:30 A.M.
Your sales conference was a great success last year.
Carpet samples are available at the front desk.
exq.why: Câu trước: phòng sẽ lắp thảm mới; câu chèn: có thể chưa xong kịp hội nghị → vì vậy (therefore) chuyển sang phòng khác.
Trước danh từ view cần tính từ: a beautiful view.
apologize for any + danh từ: disruption (sự xáo trộn).
